headline: Abated and denied fiscal year 2026 property tax amounts and settled two fiscal year 2025 Appellate Tax Board cases.
summary: The board settled two Fiscal Year 2025 Appellate Tax Board cases with abatements, then voted on Fiscal Year 2026 property tax abatements, approving some and denying others. The board also reviewed and approved new Statutory and Community Preservation Act Exemption Applications for Fiscal Year 2026.
